entries.description: v1.3 draft adopted as docs/CNB-LY-EXPORT-SPEC-v1_3.md (git mv, adoption header, links rebased, fail-loud gate noted in effect); architecture plan amended (Module 24 inventory row, section 4.1 pitchAxis line, section 4.13 addendum, Module 24 spec block, section 8 file entries).

CNBPitchAxis built per design 2.1 (positionOfSemi with fractional interpolation, regionOfSemi, distance, candidate inverses semisAtPosition/nearestSemisForY, exact linear degeneracy); grid axis path per design 2.2 (literal disabled branch, yToAxis, no scalar yToSemi, axis-aware debug overlay); Module A PA-1..PA-8 + PA-W1/W3/W4 validation and resolveNotehead xOffsetStaffSpaces. Tests 709 -> 752 (+16 config, +9 grid, +18 pitch-axis new), all byte-identity pins green: grid pre-change baseline fixture byte-identical, default export baseline, Kite export byte-identical vs base 2cf7d647 worktree.

Verification round-1 remediation (supersedes step 2 counts): section-8a fail-loud gate implemented in CNBLilypond.generate (PITCH_AXIS_GATE_MESSAGE, throws on pitchAxis.enabled before any other validation) and mirrored as a blocking error in CNBConfigExport.validateForExport (parity contract); candidate-inverse contract corrected to arrays of any length with a boundary-equality 3-candidate test. Final suite: 757 passed 0 failed (752 + 5: lilypond 56->59, config-export 26->27, pitch-axis 18->19). Kite export re-verified byte-identical vs base 2cf7d647.

Verification round-2 remediation (supersedes step 3 counts): section-8a gate condition made strict boolean (=== true, the design 1.3 consumer gate) in generate() and validateForExport, matching CNBGrid/CNBPitchAxis; regression tests for non-boolean truthy enabled values (export normal linear output; malformed truthy sections blocked by normal validation, not the gate). Final suite: 758 passed 0 failed (757 + 1: lilypond 59->60). Kite export re-verified byte-identical vs base 2cf7d647.

entries.task: Rethread every preview geometry consumer through the grid's pitch axis (design docs/planning/pitch-axis-design.md §2.3–§2.5, §3.3), keeping the axis-disabled surface byte-identical by construction. First, before any source change, capture a pre-change preview-DOM baseline fixture (CNBCollection.render through the svg/DOM stub for the default config, the Kite 4-369 config, every gallery example, a key-signature-enabled config, a debug-grid config, and the same configs with a present-but-disabled pitchAxis section) and pin it with a test. Then: CNBStaff.render dedups lines by axis position on the axis path (overrides merged) and keeps its literal loop on the linear path; CNBLedgerSet.resolve/render gain an axis path that converts to axis positions at the top, gates on axis.regionOfSemi, keeps the strict `<` proximity rule, and draws keyed by axis position, while the linear path runs the literal current arithmetic; CNBStem.direction averages axis positions against positionOfSemi(staff.midpoint) when given an enabled axis (literal body otherwise); CNBDoubleNotehead.layout accepts additive per-note lowerOffsetPx/upperOffsetPx (default 0); CNBCard computes offsetPx = xOffsetStaffSpaces × axis.unitsPerStaffSpace × pxPerSemi in axis mode only, applies it to both noteheads, the ledgers and the stem centerX, and widens columnWidth by |offsetPx|; CNBKeySignature treats separator.extentSemis as a length on the axis path and applies the same resolved offset to its marks. The collection needs no code change (everything flows through the grid context) and gets an axis-row integration test. Finally a visual test page cnb/test-pages/test-pitch-axis.html renders a compact-axis card row with the 013 Twinline map and debug grid, and a Chromium geometry smoke driver cnb/uat/uat-pitch-axis.mjs (the repo's existing driver pattern) asserts its geometry in a real browser.

Session 3 (P4) of the pitch-axis program. The engine gate is met: the engine repo's set 008-pitch-axis-hook closed 2026-07-13 and its configurator-handoff.md records E13-1 (the cnb:get-pitch-staff-position hook) and E13-2 (the x-offset field) as shipped with golden-baseline evidence. This session (1) removes the §8a fail-loud gate from cnb-lilypond.js and its mirror in the UI export wrapper in the same change that first emits the v1.3 surface: the compiled pitch-axis procedure and axis staff-line positions with collapse dedup (§5.4a/b), the axisUnitsPerStaffSpace substitutions in attachments and staff-line thickness (§4.4a/§5.3a), and the (x-offset . N) field in the Section C grouping key (§6.3), with exporter-level tests that §8 checks 8-12 (already Module A PA-1..PA-8) now block generate(), reconciled against the handoff: cnb:semitones-per-staff-space is emitted as axisUnitsPerStaffSpace under an axis (handoff §4.1) and an explicit cnb:keysig-tonic-octave is emitted under an axis (handoff §4.2, octave convention verified by the round-trip render); (2) records those reconciliations as a v1.3.1 clarification of the canonical spec; (3) adds a Twinline-family compact fixture (the 013 map, shared-pair xOffsetStaffSpaces 0.85) under cnb/assets/examples/gallery/ so it loads through CNBConfigIO via the existing gallery gate, with a pinned export baseline; (4) runs the engine round-trip (export, then lilypond 2.24.2 -dbackend=svg in the engine repo, then tools/harvest_svg.py) and commits a driver, the harvested evidence and a node measurement script that checks engine positions and x-offsets against the preview's CNBPitchAxis model, excluding the documented divergence list. All axis-disabled exports stay byte-identical (existing default and Kite baselines unchanged).

entries.reason: The architecture plan's §4.13 export-surface note still states that generate() throws on pitchAxis.enabled (the lifted §8a gate); it must be corrected alongside the spec.

The set-014 s2 preview baseline sweeps every gallery fixture to pin the axis-DISABLED (pre-rethread) preview; an axis-enabled gallery fixture has no linear baseline, so previewProbes() must skip pitchAxis-enabled fixtures (axis previews are covered by the s2 axis render tests).

A shared-position chord pair is already separated by LilyPond's own arrangement (+0.49 here), so the x-offset effect is measured test-minus-control (engine set 008 s2 method): the control export, score, SVG and harvest join the evidence; measure.mjs reads the key-signature marks from the SVGs, so both SVGs are kept.

entries.task: Finish the pitch-axis implementation (design phases P5 and P6). Build the pitch-axis editor panel (cnb/ui/pitch-axis-editor.js) on the Modules 12–17 editor contract: property-based event wiring, a Node-testable render(), pure stateFromConfig/buildPitchAxis/applyToConfig builders and Module A validation pass-through. It edits enable, kind, octaveStride, axisUnitsPerStaffSpace and the 12 per-pc positions, and offers one preset, "Twinline-like 7-position", which compiles into the explicit design §1.1 map plus a named notehead rule carrying the shared-pair xOffsetStaffSpaces. The editor never creates a pitchAxis section the user did not ask for, so default configs stay byte-identical. Let the notehead rule editor keep and edit apply.xOffsetStaffSpaces; today its builder drops the field, so loading the Twinline fixture loses its offsets. Wire the panel into the app shell, cnb/index.html (the repository has no cnb/ui/app.js; index.html is the shell that the plan's app.js entry stands for). Re-tier feasibility-matrix records 32–40 as a dated amendment, with the twinline-compact fixture and the session-3 engine round-trip as evidence. Record the operator's verbatim UAT decision in docs/sessions/uat-session-4.md. Close out the pitch-axis work in docs/sessions/change-log.md.

Make the browser UAT reproducible from a fresh clone. Add a private root package.json with no runtime dependencies that declares playwright-core as its only devDependency (with the generated package-lock.json committed and node_modules/ ignored), a `test` script (`node cnb/tests/run-tests.js`) and a `uat` script that runs a small sequential runner, cnb/uat/run-uat.mjs, which spawns every cnb/uat/uat-*.mjs driver in turn and exits non-zero on the first failure; document `npm install` and `npx playwright install chromium` in the README. The drivers already resolve playwright-core from their own location first (which reaches the repository's node_modules) and fall back to CNB_UAT_PLAYWRIGHT; their not-found messages are updated to point at `npm install` at the repository root. Then run every driver (there are eleven uat-*.mjs files, not the ten the plan counts: uat-gallery-previews.mjs is a capture tool and is included), fix whatever drift broke in the drivers or the app, and record each driver's result in docs/uat-status.md. Finally declare the UAT run as a second suite `cnb-uat` in dabbler.yaml (`command: npm run uat`, expensive, whole_at_close, runs_whole, covers [cnb/]) and update the comment there that says the drivers are undeclared.
